Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: In the final analysis step (Step 10), the Planner incorrectly interpreted the frequency of sunrise. The previous search results (Step 1) explicitly stated that sunrise occurs "Every day" and that NOAA satellites watch the sun rise and set daily. However, the Planner erroneously concluded that sunrise occurs "approximately 1 time per year per location" based on a "polar reference," effectively ignoring the standard global context where sunrise happens daily. This fundamental error in interpreting the definition of sunrise led to the false conclusion that the Full Moon (12-13 times/year) is more frequent than sunrise (which is ~365 times/year), resulting in the wrong final answer.
